verdict.rationale: The skill publishes its own plugin marketplace entry (`/plugin marketplace add` plus `/plugin install`). It also documents copying the folder into a project skills directory, which can be committed to a shared repo, and it uses the open Agent Skills format with a packaging script for uploads. Together these cover the marketplace and committed-files distribution routes. Missing for 10: explicit team-wide rollout guidance (e.g., version pinning, org-level distribution), the fact that it is a single skill rather than a curated skill set, and independent or hands-on corroboration of team distribution.
